title: Q5
description:
“What is man that You are mindful of him, or the son of man that You take care of him?”
Read: Psa 8 (whole psalm), Gen 1:26–28
a) Psa 8 echoes Gen 1: man made to rule over the works of God's hands. What does that creation background bring forward into the passage that a simple statement about Jesus could not?
